defs.def: a structure made of wood or wire supported with posts that is put between two areas of land as a boundary, or around a garden/yard, field, etc. to keep animals in, or to keep people and animals out 栅栏；篱笆；围栏

ex.s: Some fences keep foxes out of henhouses, for instance.
ex.t: 例如，一些栅栏可以防止狐狸进入鸡舍。

ex.s: When faced with such a fence, Chesterton thinks the fact that we can’t see the point of the fence is why we should not tear it down.
ex.t: 面对这样的栅栏，Chesterton认为，正因为我们看不出它的意义，才更不应该拆掉它。

ex.s: I looked around and finally spotted David, who was standing by himself off to the side by a fence.
ex.t: 我环顾四周，终于看到了David，他独自站在围栏旁边的一侧。

ex.s: I looked around and finally spotted David, who was standing by himself off to the side by a fence.
ex.t: 我环顾四周，终于看到了David，他独自站在围栏旁边的一侧。

ex.s: The hungry bear followed his nose to our camp，which was surrounded by a high wire fence.
ex.t: 那只饥饿的熊循着气味来到我们的营地，营地四周围着高高的铁丝网。

ex.s: So I approached our uninvited guest slowly and，through the fence，sprayed him in the face.
ex.t: 于是我慢慢接近这位不速之客，隔着栅栏朝它脸上喷了胡椒喷雾。

ex.s: Putting electric fencing around chicken houses and other farm animal quarters is also highly effective at getting grizzlies away.
ex.t: 在鸡舍和其他家畜栏舍周围安装电围栏，对驱赶灰熊也非常有效。

ex.s: Confucius Good fences make good neighbours.
ex.t: 孔子好篱笆造就好邻居。

ex.s: His father gave him a bag of nails and told him that every time he lost his temper, he must hammer a nail into the back of the fence.
ex.t: 他的父亲给了他一袋钉子，告诉他每次发脾气时，他必须在篱笆背面钉一根钉子。

ex.s: The first day, the boy hammered so many nails into the fence that his father had to give him a whole new bag.
ex.t: 第一天，男孩在篱笆上钉了那么多钉子，他父亲只好又给了他一整袋新钉子。

ex.s: He had learnt that it was easier to hold his temper than to hammer nails into the fence.
ex.t: 他学会了控制脾气比往篱笆上钉钉子更容易。

ex.s: When Spot and Stripe were four months old, they were learning how to open doors and jump fences, and we knew it really was time for them to go.
ex.t: 当Spot和Stripe四个月大时，它们正在学习如何开门和翻越围栏，我们知道它们真的该走了。

ex.s: Imagine there is a fence along a road.
ex.t: 想象一条路旁有一道栅栏。

ex.s: To us, now, the fence seems to be nothing but an impediment.
ex.t: 对我们现在来说，这道栅栏似乎只不过是个障碍。

ex.s: If you think you can do without the fence because you’ve never seen a fox, consider if the existence of the fence is precisely why you’ve never seen one.
ex.t: 如果你认为自己不需要围栏，因为你从没见过狐狸，那不妨想想：也许正是因为有了围栏，你才从没见过狐狸。

ex.s: “Tom Sawyer: A River Adventure” has all the good stuff, including the fence painting, the graveyard, the island and the cave.
ex.t: 《汤姆·索亚：河流冒险》包含所有精彩元素，包括刷栅栏、墓地、小岛和山洞。

ex.s: It crashed through a wooden fence and disappeared.
ex.t: 它撞穿一道木栅栏后消失了。

ex.s: Elli and I feared the fence wouldn't last through 30 more minutes of the bear's punishment.
ex.t: Elli和我担心栅栏撑不过熊再30分钟的破坏。

ex.s: Over the next few weeks, as he learnt to control his anger, he hammered fewer and fewer nails into the fence each day.
ex.t: 在接下来的几周里，当他学会控制自己的愤怒时，他每天钉在篱笆上的钉子越来越少。

ex.s: He stood on his back legs and pushed at the wooden fence posts.
ex.t: 它用后腿站起来，推着木栅栏的柱子。
